context: Mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 稀/読み方/目先/義父/うるさく/柔らかい/恥ずかしく/嫁さん

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、稀、絶対、に、絶対、見る、絶対、お花、絶対、咲いてるわよ
lines.en: Sho, you really should see those rare flowers blooming.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. Patient tone of a mother pointing out something worth noticing. Warm but not coddling. Slow enough for a child to absorb.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、この漢字の、本気で、絶対、読み方、絶対、教えて
lines.en: Mom, how do you read this kanji?
lines.style: Soft, focused questioning. Genuine curiosity without urgency. The small voice of a child concentrating hard on something just beyond him. No frustration yet.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、目先、絶対、のことだけ、絶対、考えちゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, don't only think about what's right in front of you.
lines.style: Steady, instructive without harshness. A mother offering guidance as she continues her quiet task. Even tone, clear pacing. The weight of a lesson delivered gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、義父、絶対、っていう言葉、絶対、初めて聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I've never heard the word 'stepfather' before.
lines.style: Quiet wonder mixed with slight uncertainty. A child processing something new and important. Hesitant delivery, not defensive. Seeking confirmation more than information.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、うるさく、絶対、しないでね、お父さん、絶対、お休み中
lines.en: Sho, don't be loud now, okay? Your dad is resting.
lines.style: Quiet, practical direction. A mother's voice lowered for the sake of someone else's rest. Not stern, but firm with gentle purpose. Almost conspiratorial in tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お枕、本気で、絶対、柔らかい、絶対、ね
lines.en: Mom, this pillow is really soft.
lines.style: Delighted small voice. A child making a simple discovery and wanting to share it. Brief, genuine pleasure. No performance, just wonder at something tactile and nice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、恥ずかしく、絶対、なんかないわよ
lines.en: Sho, there's nothing to be embarrassed about.
lines.style: Warm reassurance delivered matter-of-factly. A mother reading what her son hasn't quite said. Steady eye contact implied. Kind but not overly soothing—confidence that can be borrowed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お兄ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、嫁さん、絶対、優しい人だね
lines.en: Mom, your brother's wife is a really kind person.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. A child noticing something true and wanting it acknowledged. Thoughtful pause built in. The small voice of someone who watches people carefully.
